title: Story Recovery Priorities
purpose: Guide future conversation and archive mining toward concrete story material: people, exchanges, daily incidents, creative work and turning points. Unknowns remain recovery targets rather than invented prose.

priorities.target: Recover original Marty Biz Music conversations, disagreements, creative exchanges, friendship texture and the contemporaneous grief material that later becomes the Goodbye Marty thread.
Recover May 2026 Sarah Ann exchanges turn by turn: return to stream, jokes, theological questions, criticism, practical-help conflict and aftermath.
Locate the strongest surviving source for the remembered 2017 Josh Moon confrontation and preserve exact speaker order separately from later Tim retellings.
Recover Monkey / OPS / Tree Discord chronology: entry, trust, conflict, removal/return and what Tim said at each stage.
Separate documentary BigTech interactions from Great Book literary BigTech and recover the original public rivalry/conversation layer.
Recover Sammy across the Son/Tammuz mourning lead, Marty period and later Potatoverse social cast without collapsing later interpretation into contemporaneous wording.
Determine who Grace, Ben Thorp and Metalorian are in the surviving project record, when they enter, and which concrete interactions deserve Story treatment.
Separate Great Book/project Capy from recoverable documentary interactions and map the Sammy/BigTech/Tim connections if sources survive.
Recover Tim's real interactions and commentary around Cyraxx and Robotosan separately from the Great Book elevator fiction.
Index the strongest scenes and dialogue for Fresh Potato, Ready Student, Grumbleton, Ethereal Tuber, Rahu, Optimistique, Elder Grapes, Sentinel of Silence, Kibly/Kibbly and machine beings.
Track first and changing uses of Dogs, Farmers, Soul Farmers, Mud Dwellers, Dwellers, cows/calves, swine, sheep, serpents, hyenas and goats by period rather than treating them as static definitions.
Recover when Angels become Potato Angels, what 'grow potato angels' meant in surrounding conversation, and whether named angels or individual Potato figures appear in older chats.
Map the recovered Suno/music catalogue to the event or conversation that produced each track when possible, especially grief, Dog, North, MoonCube, narrow-gate and self-parody songs.
Recover actual development sessions for Potato Growth Game, Trading Game, AI Potato Town, Potato School, Mashy Arc, Infinite Potato and visual-composition projects as events in Tim's life.
Preserve short recurring public exchanges such as Nate, Ann and other repeat interlocutors so ordinary relationship texture survives beside major declarations.

Recover the full May 27-28, 2026 sequence around AI recognizing the philosophy without Tim, including exact dialogue, Sarah Ann context where relevant, and the move toward provenance/archive building.
Recover the original July 21 wall-practice conversation/transcript behind the preserved ordered sequence before expanding the scene further.
